raw: {"verdict": "pass", "reason": "The patch adds a properly labelled optional Note textarea (maxLength 500) and labels the Name and Phone inputs too. The API schema trims the note and rejects anything over 500 characters before `createBooking` runs; the server stores an empty note as NULL and keeps inner line breaks. The admin card renders the note as escaped plain text with `whitespace-pre-wrap`, so line breaks show."}
